correctness.rationale: The final claim is the entire antipodally even spectrum, not a universal polytope inequality: for 1<c<3 the 14 facets split into eight diagonal and six coordinate facets. The stated facet-mass/edge-conductance formulas change at c=2, where they agree; on the seven-dimensional even quotient the diagonal contrasts (dimension 3), coordinate contrasts (dimension 2), and two class constants diagonalize the generalized Laplacian with eigenvalues T=(4d+3a)/u, S=(4a+6b)/v and M=3a/u+4a/v besides 0. Reconstructed the facet-adjacency derivation and the eigenvector decomposition. Independently reproduced exact rational Laplacian action on a complete 7-vector basis at c=6/5,7/4,5/2 using 14 facet vertices; verified symbolically the two chamber derivatives, crossing polynomial 3c²−7c+3 and value S((7+sqrt(13))/6)=1+sqrt(13). The analytic proof establishes the all-real open interval; the three samples merely corroborate its algebra. The minimum is min(T,S), maximized uniquely at c*=(7+sqrt(13))/6; multiplicities change 3→5→2. Scope is strictly antipodal-even weighted operator and 1<c<3.
